scope: 0529 certificate-only cross-lineage review. Existing certificate bytes, saved permitted C4R3/T120L inputs and synthetic arithmetic. P128 coverage primary; P64 coverage supporting.

findings.finding: EPS CERTIFIED satisfies the recorded registered refinement rule. Correct envelope estimates are published separately. For first3 shells eps and eps_max represent actual-set estimates, not the cardinal-torus envelope.
findings.deciding_step: A consumer requiring the full torus-envelope bound must use eps_envelope / envelope_bound.eps_max_envelope_all_shells (or max of actual/envelope), not the low-shell eps alone.

findings.finding: Search results are numerical maximum estimates. At shell300 the independent value exceeds the record by1.52264e-8 relative (5.55e-16 absolute). No rigorous global upper-bound proof is furnished.
findings.deciding_step: Retain numerical-estimate labeling and the registered acceptance convention; do not promote these to proved suprema.

findings.finding: LO V002 is built from the saved C4R3 le3 source at M_s64. Changing to M_s128 changes S_T, hence its absolute shell integral. The recorded bound has no demonstrated mathematical transfer to M_s128, even though M_s128 GQ passes.
findings.deciding_step: Before using this LO record to qualify a different M_s128 source, recompute matched-source LO integrals or supply a certified bound on their difference. This is not a failure of the reviewed Ms64 arithmetic.

findings.finding: Non-lapse share of lnN is zero for valid metric evaluations. Non-lapse changes can still fail SPD/other guards; zero share is not unconditional admission.
findings.deciding_step: Preserve valid-metric qualification. Synthetic invalid-SPD control is correctly refused.

findings.finding: Honest NGC I1-T certifies stored T120L iteration-zero represented stars+H2+initialHI only. Continuum tail-source representation and downstream consumer enforcement are not tested by this review.
findings.deciding_step: Retain exact scope and require any separately registered continuum/source admission evidence before making that different claim.

verdict_meaning: Requested independent checks reproduce claimed numerical quantities within stated precision and confirm GQ negative/positive controls. This does not certify an entire P128 production stack or transfer Ms64 LO to Ms128.

coverage.GQ: GQ labels reach362 but generator samples a cylinder with k_perp and |k_z| up to362; it therefore contains the physical cylinder256. Do not interpret362 as a spherical truncation.

errors_corrected_without_overwrite: Initial LO helper refused platform metadata subprocess before creation. Immutable successor uses direct libm J0 with no subprocess.
EPS V001 blind search missed high-shell global candidate. V002 adds own low-shell optimum as a high-shell start; prior files retained.
LO blind rho search found a smaller local maximum. Supplement independently evaluates producer extremum and locally attempts to refute it; no claim of rigorous global supremum.
